description:
The CLS/SCLS research track now lives in crates/outram-mc-libs/src/stochastic/ (op-eby scaffold), but the pre-existing RSA sphere-packing module remains at pebble_beds::stochastic_media. Two similarly-named homes for stochastic-media code is a navigability wart for a reader using rust-analyzer alone (workspace 'Human interface layer' rule).

Argument to move it: RSA packing IS stochastic-media geometry, applies to any dispersion fuel, and stochastic::medium::RsaMedium already wraps it.
Argument to leave it: it was written as part of the doubly-heterogeneous delta-tracking path and pebble_beds::keff_delta depends on it directly.

Not done as part of the scaffold move because it is pre-existing working code with 6 dependents (keff_delta.rs, references.rs, prelude.rs, examples/triso_delta_tracking.rs, examples/triso_gpu_benchmark.rs, tests/openmc_notebooks/triso.rs) — a wider refactor than the scaffold relocation the maintainer asked for.

If moved: use findReferences per the workspace LSP rule, then let the compiler catch every missed path; re-verify the two examples and the triso integration test.
title: outram-mc: decide whether pebble_beds::stochastic_media should move into the stochastic module

description: Follow-up to op-57m first slice: use decomposition::krylov (or a generalisation) as the linear stage inside the actual RICHARDS/transport Newton solve on the real assembled Jacobian, add a distributed preconditioner, and extend to 2-D/3-D Cartesian (cart_create/cart_shift) and unstructured partitioning.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: First slice done (committed 7d321ed): 2-D Cartesian block decomposition + distributed CG in decomposition::cartesian2d, verified == serial across process grids {1x1,2x2,4x2,3x1,1x4}. Remaining for this bead: (1) wire the distributed CG as the linear stage of the real RICHARDS/transport Newton solve on the assembled Jacobian; (2) distributed preconditioner; (3) 3-D and unstructured partitioning.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Second slice done (committed): krylov::distributed_cg_with generalised the distributed CG to an arbitrary matvec closure (no trait object), and operator::DiffusionOperator1D is a real variable-coefficient (heterogeneous-k, harmonic-mean transmissibility) 1-D diffusion operator -- the shape of a real Darcy/conduction Jacobian block -- verified == serial across ranks {1,2,3,5,8} incl a cell-for-cell matvec check. Still open: wire into the actual assembled LduMatrix Jacobian in the Newton loop; distributed preconditioner; 2-D/3-D variable-coefficient operators.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Third slice done (committed): distributed Jacobi-preconditioned CG -- krylov::distributed_pcg_with (generic preconditioner closure) + DiffusionOperator1D::diagonal()/solve_jacobi_pcg (local diagonal solve, zero extra comm). Verified == serial across ranks {1,2,4}, PCG iters <= CG iters. Remaining: wire the distributed CG/PCG into pflotran's ACTUAL assembled LduMatrix Jacobian inside the RICHARDS/transport Newton loop; 2-D/3-D variable-coefficient operators.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Fourth slice done (committed): distributed solve of the REAL assembled LduMatrix. assemble_diffusion_ldu builds a genuine outram_foam_basic_lib LduMatrix; DistributedLduMatrix1D extracts per-rank rows + distributed SpMV verified == LduMatrix::multiply cell-for-cell; distributed CG == serial across ranks. Remaining: per-rank local assembly (vs extract-from-global), and the NON-symmetric transport Jacobian path (distributed BiCGStab) inside the real Newton/timestep loop; 2-D/3-D.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Fifth slice done (committed): distributed BiCGStab (krylov::distributed_bicgstab_with) for NON-symmetric systems + assemble_advection_diffusion_ldu (upwind advection -> non-symmetric LduMatrix) + solve_bicgstab, verified == serial BiCGStab across ranks {1,2,3,4,8}. The distributed toolkit now covers symmetric (CG/PCG) and non-symmetric (BiCGStab) solves on the REAL LduMatrix. Remaining: per-rank local assembly (vs from-global) and calling solve_bicgstab as the linear stage inside the actual transport/RICHARDS timestep+Newton loop; 2-D/3-D.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Sixth slice done (committed): truly-distributed per-rank assembly -- DistributedLduMatrix1D::assemble_diffusion_local builds local rows from local k + halo, no global matrix; verified bit-identical to from_global + solves == serial. Distributed toolkit now complete: local assembly + CG/PCG (symmetric) + BiCGStab (non-symmetric) on the real LduMatrix. Remaining is ORCHESTRATION: call these inside the real transport/RICHARDS timestep+Newton loop, + 2-D/3-D partitioned assembly.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Seventh slice done (committed): distributed transport TIMESTEP matching the real serial SoluteTransport. DistributedTransport1D assembles the transport operator (accumulation + upwind advection + dispersion) per rank and solves with distributed BiCGStab; 6 backward-Euler steps reproduce the real crate::transport::SoluteTransport cell-for-cell across ranks {1,2,3,4}. The distributed solver is now wired into a real pflotran timestep loop (by composition). Remaining: non-uniform flow / TVD / Dirichlet BCs, RICHARDS + energy timesteps, 2-D/3-D.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Eighth slice done (committed): distributed transport generalised to NON-UNIFORM flow (per-face flux/dispersion, upwind by local sign; new/uniform/from_global_flow constructors). Verified == serial SoluteTransport with an accelerating +x flux across ranks {1,2,3,4,6}. Remaining: Dirichlet BCs + TVD, RICHARDS/energy timesteps, 2-D/3-D.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Ninth slice done (committed): distributed transport with Dirichlet boundary conditions (EndCondition enum: Closed/Flux/Dirichlet, matching serial boundary assembly). Verified == serial SoluteTransport with an XMin inflow-concentration BC + XMax outflow across ranks {1,2,3,4}. Distributed transport now covers uniform+non-uniform flow and closed+Dirichlet boundaries. Remaining: TVD deferred-correction; RICHARDS/energy timesteps; 2-D/3-D.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Tenth slice done (committed): distributed TVD deferred-correction (uniform +x, 2-wide upwind halo) + a real BiCGStab robustness FIX. Found the distributed BiCGStab returned unconverged solutions on advection-dominated (low-dispersion) matrices (classic rho->0 breakdown, masked by dispersion in prior tests); fixed by restart-on-breakdown (recompute residual + fresh shadow vector). Distributed pure-advection AND SuperBee-TVD now match serial across ranks {1,2,3,4}. Remaining: RICHARDS/energy timesteps, 2-D/3-D transport.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Eleventh slice done (committed): distributed ENERGY (heat) transport via DistributedTransport1D::from_energy_flow -- same advection-conduction stencil with heat coefficients (c_v*V accumulation, rho_w*c_w*q advection, kappa_eff*geom conduction). Verified == serial EnergyTransport with a Dirichlet inflow temperature across ranks {1,2,3,4}. Driver now covers solute + energy transport. Remaining: nonlinear RICHARDS flow timestep (distributed Newton), 2-D/3-D.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Twelfth slice done (committed): distributed NEWTON solver (decomposition::newton::distributed_newton) -- the nonlinear-solve framework RICHARDS/GENERAL need. Residual closure + tridiagonal Jacobian closure; each iter: F + global norm (all_reduce), distributed Jacobian solve (BiCGStab), update. Verified vs serial Newton on nonlinear reaction-diffusion across ranks {1,2,3,4,5}, residual ~0. Final step: wire pflotran's exact RICHARDS residual/Jacobian (van Genuchten + EOS + upstream mobility + gravity) into it. 2-D/3-D also remain.

title: pflotran: wire distributed CG into the real Newton/Jacobian + preconditioning + multi-D partition

description: Follow-ups from op-6w0.4 (cyclic): (1) extend the polyMesh parser to read cyclic neighbourPatch + half0/half1 face ordering so cyclic pairs load from constant/polyMesh (currently programmatic via periodic_1d/new_cyclic only); (2) teach the symmetric iterative solvers (DIC-PCG, GAMG) about the appended seam LDU faces so cyclic problems aren't restricted to Gauss-Seidel; (3) add non-orthogonal seam correction and rotational (rotating-cyclic) transform (currently orthogonal translational periodicity only).
title: outram-foam-basic-lib: cyclic follow-ups — polyMesh cyclic neighbourPatch read + symmetric-solver (DIC-PCG/GAMG) seam support + non-orthogonal/rotational cyclic
